prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling subway platform. On the far left stands a tall man in a blue coat, leaning heavily against a cracked tile wall. Next to him sits a small child in a yellow hat, swinging their legs above the dirty floor. A silver briefcase rests beside the child, its latches gleaming faintly. The man in the blue coat looks at the child with a tired expression. In the center of the frame, a woman in a green dress holds a crumpled map, pointing urgently at a specific street name. Beside her, an elderly gentleman in a grey suit listens intently, nodding his head slowly. A black umbrella leans against the gentleman's leg, its handle curved and worn. To the right of this pair, a teenager in a hoodie scrolls through a phone, ignoring the world around them. A stray cat with orange fur weaves between the teenager's feet, seeking warmth. The teenager glances down at the cat briefly before returning to the screen. Further right, a couple stands close together; the person in the red jacket hands a ticket to their partner in a white shirt. Behind them, a large digital clock displays the time in bright red numbers, though the digits are slightly blurred. Above the crowd, a flickering fluorescent light buzzes silently, casting long, soft shadows. A discarded newspaper lies on the ground near the tracks, its headlines unreadable. A pigeon perches on a metal bench nearby, cooing softly. There is no advertisement poster on the walls. There is no train visible on the tracks.
